summary.en: Caiyang Yu is a Lecturer at the College of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, Wenzhou University, and a member of the MDM&CI (Medical Data Mining and Computational Intelligence) research group led by Prof. Huiling Chen. He received his Ph.D. from the College of Computer Science, Sichuan University, under the supervision of Prof. Jiancheng Lv. His research interests include graph machine learning, neural architecture search, and medical multimodal information processing. He is committed to exploring efficient, reliable, and generalizable intelligent computing methods for complex data and real-world application scenarios.
summary.zh: 俞蔡阳，温州大学计算机与人工智能学院讲师，现为陈慧灵教授领导的 MDM&CI（Medical Data Mining and Computational Intelligence）课题组成员。博士毕业于四川大学计算机学院，师从吕建成教授。主要研究兴趣包括图机器学习、神经架构搜索以及医学多模态信息处理等，致力于面向复杂数据与实际应用场景，探索高效、可靠且具有泛化能力的智能计算方法。
